files.name: dochi_rpg_maker-0.3.0-1.20.1-forge.jar
files.changelogHtml:
0.3.0 Change Log

Common Changes

  • Added independent text boxes to the Dialogue GUI Editor for displaying NPC names and custom text. Supports multiple text boxes, duplication, and saving.
  • Added an optional API for addon integration, allowing access to and creation of NPC clone templates from mods such as DNPC.
  • Improved keybind category sorting to keep Dochi's mod categories grouped together.

Fabric / NeoForge 1.21.1 & 26.3

  • Fixed an issue where Creative Tab search failed when used alongside mods such as Axiom.
  • Fixed camera jitter when tracking moving entities or using previews in the Scene Maker.

Fabric / NeoForge 1.21.1

  • Added the ability to delete trainer battle records through the Admin menu (Cobble NPC integration).
  • Added manual cleanup of battle records for despawned trainers.

Forge 1.20.1 / Fabric / NeoForge 1.21.1

  • Fixed a crash when using NPC model animations without CNPC installed.
  • Improved Creative Tab integration by registering DRM tools directly under the DNPC and CNPC tabs.

files.name: dochi_npc_core-0.1.2-neoforge-26.3.jar
files.changelogHtml:
0.1.2 Change Log

Global

Fixed
  • Fixed carried blocks and contents disappearing when applying templates to existing NPCs.
  • Fixed carried items being copied to newly cloned NPCs.
  • Fixed old mount records, timeout data, squad states, and combat progress persisting in new NPCs or clones.
  • Fixed NPC jobs interfering with movement and actions controlled by other mods.
  • Fixed hired NPCs failing to resume jobs and contract expiration handling after external control ends.
  • Fixed DRM scheduled shops remaining accessible after closing, being disabled, or switching shops.
Improved
  • Improved NPC pathfinding accuracy.

Forge 1.20.1 / Fabric & NeoForge 1.21.1

Added
  • Added NPC deletion using the Delete key in the NPC screen.
  • Added Farmer's Delight cooking jobs.
Improved
  • Improved default job schedules.
Fixed
  • Fixed NPCs waiting unnecessarily in front of trees that cannot be chopped.
  • Fixed NPCs returning after mining only one block.
  • Fixed incorrect songs playing during Immersive Melodies performances or after resuming.
  • Fixed fuel and ingredients disappearing during cooking.
  • Fixed empty buckets not being returned after cheese production.
  • Fixed cooking stations becoming unusable after resetting pizza jobs.

Fabric & NeoForge 1.21.1

Fixed
  • Fixed stationary Cobblemon trainers being unable to dash and return to position.
  • Fixed trainers failing to lock their position again after movement.

Fabric 1.21.1 / Fabric & NeoForge 26.3

Fixed
  • Fixed previous movement and sleep states interfering with external NPC control.

NeoForge 1.21.1

Added
  • Added cutting board, furnace, smoker, pizza assembly, and French Delight cheese mold jobs.
  • Added ingredient and product transfers using baskets and cabinets.
  • Added cabinet opening and closing animations during cooking jobs.

files.name: dochi_warfare-0.3.1-neoforge-1.21.1.jar
files.changelogHtml:
0.3.1 Change Log

Update Notice: Version 0.3.1 adds compatibility with DNPC (Dochi's NPC Core). Users who only use CNPC (CustomNPCs) do not need to update.

Global

Added
  • Added DW firearm and melee combat support for DNPC without requiring CNPC.
  • Added support for DNPC's friendly/hostile relationships and friendly group protection.
  • Added movement slowdown during reloading and stationary shooting for DNPC.
  • Added DNPC configuration, pose preview, and event dialogue integration.
  • Added support for DNPC's Military Bed "Wake Up When Damaged" setting.
  • Added PointBlank firearm model previews in the DNPC Pose Editor.
  • Added checkbox selection, Select All, and Delete Selected to weapon, armor, and skin lists.
Changed
  • Changed DW combat behavior to respect DNPC's external AI control.
  • Changed DW to preserve movement paths, targets, and equipment during external control.
  • Changed DW to resume combat when external control ends.
  • Changed DW tools to appear in DNPC and CNPC Creative Tabs when available.
  • Changed the layout of NPC, pose, booby trap, clone, and mercenary editors.
  • Changed the Pose Editor layout into separate editing and preview sections.
Improved
  • Improved movement speed restoration when DW combat control ends.
  • Improved editor buttons, input fields, and overall UI visibility.
  • Improved settings categories and back/forward navigation.
  • Improved profile search and scrolling.
  • Improved skin previews, preset cards, descriptions, and scroll indicators.
  • Improved button spacing, text alignment, and long weapon name wrapping.
  • Improved panel background rendering.
Fixed
  • Fixed automatic switching between firearms and melee weapons repeatedly stopping.
  • Fixed incorrect text in the overview and probability totals.
  • Fixed probability values disappearing during list editing or page navigation.

NeoForge 1.21.1

Fixed
  • Fixed a crash when opening the Mercenary Configuration screen.

files.name: dochi_warfare_expanded-0.3.1-neoforge-1.21.1.jar
files.changelogHtml:
0.3.1 Change Log

Update Notice: Version 0.3.1 adds compatibility with DNPC (Dochi's NPC Core). Users who only use CNPC (CustomNPCs) do not need to update. Important: Update both DW and DWE together.

Global

Added
  • Added DNPC crew support for vehicle drivers, gunners, and other crew roles.
  • Added DNPC friendly/hostile relationship support for vehicle targeting and ally protection.
  • Added combat dismount support for DNPC crews without requiring CNPC.
  • Added support for Superb Warfare 0.8.9.2 vehicles.
  • Added settings for handling NPC crews when vehicles are destroyed.
Changed
  • Changed vehicle AI ammo and weapon processing to reduce unnecessary repeated operations.
Improved
  • Improved update warnings when using incompatible older DW versions.
  • Improved vehicle AI performance by reducing redundant processing.
Fixed
  • Fixed AH-6 patrols failing to aim and fire fixed machine guns at ground targets.
  • Fixed fixed-wing aircraft failing to aim with mounted weapons.
  • Fixed fixed-wing aircraft climbing excessively near unloaded terrain.
  • Fixed reloads taking too long after restoring vehicles from another world.
  • Fixed ammo duplication and magazine capacity overflow when changing ammo settings during reloading.
  • Fixed vehicles incorrectly blocking their own fire as friendly obstacles.
  • Fixed unresponsive entries in crew and Soulstone selection screens.
Expanded Addon Compatibility

Verified vehicle AI movement, firing, and reloading with NPC crews.

Addon Supported Versions Verified Vehicles
AshVehicle Forge 1.20.1 / NeoForge 1.21.1 M3A3 Bradley, AH-64, F-22
HaloVehicles Forge 1.20.1 / NeoForge 1.21.1 M12 HMG
MCSP Forge 1.20.1 / NeoForge 1.21.1 M3A3 Bradley
Vintage Vehicle Pack (VVP) Forge 1.20.1 BMP-2
Frontline Combat Pack (FCP) Forge 1.20.1 BMP-2
Spectacular Machines Addon (SMA) Forge 1.20.1 Type 10
  • Compatibility is verified for the listed vehicles only. Not all vehicles or special weapons are supported.

files.name: dochi_spawn_control-0.1.5-neoforge-1.21.1.jar
files.changelogHtml:
0.1.5 Change Log

Global

Added
  • Added biome and structure ID/tag filters with inclusion and exclusion lists.
  • Added shared guard squad composition and equipment across all supported loaders.
  • Added persistent per-structure squad limits and respawn delays.
Fixed
  • Fixed nested location pickers showing parent controls and editor labels through their panels.
  • Fixed oversized advanced diagnostics and kept long results inside a scrollable viewport.
Changed
  • Changed guard equipment clearing to standalone switches beside item selectors.
  • Changed spawn placement choices to inline dropdowns.
Improved
  • Improved guard flyouts with section dividers and visible structure linkage guidance.
  • Improved guard forms with compact actions, aligned fields, and readable selection summaries.

Fabric & NeoForge 26.3

Added
  • Added saved DNPC clone templates to natural spawn rules.

files.changelogHtml:
0.1.6 Change Log

MWENT card additions, specifications, and opening tactics: 0.1.6 card notes.

Global

Added
  • Added faction and mechanic-specific MWENT card sound effects with CC0 source credits.
  • Added seven siege engine models with loading and firing animations.
  • Added card creator options for the new mechanics, effect costs, and siege commands.
  • Added saved opening tactic choices in the deck builder.
  • Added configurable MWENT player, player-versus-AI, and AI-versus-AI table matches.
  • Added optional spectator cameras and hand visibility settings.
  • Added commands to start or cancel AI table matches and enter spectator view.
  • Added spectator item betting with refunds and persistent settlements.
  • Added craftable roulette machines with weighted prizes, direct right-click play, and in-world prize effects.
  • Added shared reward conditions, selection policies, and persistent pending rewards across minigames.
  • Added optional Cobblemon Pokemon prizes with party and PC delivery.
Fixed
  • Fixed DNPC Gecko cards showing default appearances instead of their selected models.
  • Fixed misplaced deck selection hitboxes and controls overlapping the selected card list.
  • Fixed modified card states being lost during draws, revivals, or AI predictions.
  • Fixed hidden trap identities leaking to opponents and spectators.
  • Fixed Ender Dragon battlefield models appearing smaller than ordinary troops.
Improved
  • Improved MWENT audio mixing by suppressing overlapping voices and repeated area impacts.
  • Improved spinning slot performance.
  • Improved MWENT betting amount field sizing.

Forge 1.20.1

Added
  • Added optional siege engine palettes using compatible Create and Big Cannons blocks.

Fabric & NeoForge 26.3

Fixed
  • Fixed missing Controls category names.
